The '''Storinal spaceport bunker''' was used to house [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] to protect the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Storinal]]. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Mission to Storinal|infiltrated]] the bunker to steal some of their fighters while posing as the crew of the [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']].
